title.en: Parishes, Finland, Estonia and other areas 1938, 1:1 000 000

description.en:
Parishes  (socken/pitäjäs) are areas used in dialect research. These are close to the adminstrative borders in ca 1938. This dataset data for Finland's area as in 1938, Estonia and some areas in other neighbouring countries.

Coordinate Reference System: ETRS89 / ETRS-TM35FIN (EPSG:3067)

creator: Institute for the Languages of Finland

values: Kotimaisten kielten keskus / Institute for the Languages of Finland
